Where does your flush actually go? 🚽
Screens catch wipes and grit, tanks settle the solids, bacteria break down the waste, and treated water goes back to rivers. Thames Water alone treats 4,600 million litres of sewage a day, and the sludge is turned into biogas for power. The average sewer is only 15cm wide, so only flush the 3 Ps: pee, paper and poo.
